content: Geometry of arginines at PDB interfaces, from all atoms within 10 Å (first model): relative solvent accessibility of the residue alone and in the complex (Shrake-Rupley, Arg maximum 274 Å²), Levy (2010) class (core, rim, support or none), surface buried by nucleic acid and by protein, the kind of nucleic-acid contact (base or backbone hydrogen bond, contact, none), the bases hydrogen-bonded and the number of protein hydrogen bonds; empty measures: the residue at that index is not an arginine
citation: Levy, J Mol Biol 403:660 (2010); Shrake & Rupley, J Mol Biol 79:351 (1973); Tien et al., PLoS ONE 8:e80635 (2013)
how_made_or_checked: scripts/37 analyze_environment on each saved neighbourhood (the raw atoms are not kept in Git)

content: Methylarginines measured in predicted complexes (ProtVar served AlphaFold-Multimer models with pDockQ >= 0.5, and AlphaFold DB human heterodimers): arginines within 5 Å of the partner, the closest distance, bonds (salt bridge to Asp/Glu carboxylate O <= 4 Å, hydrogen bond to an acceptor O or His ND1/NE2 <= 3.5 Å, cation-pi to an aromatic ring <= 5 Å), a clash (< 2.2 Å), pLDDT, and the partner residues named as chain:residue:bonds; measured at the positions of the v1.1.0 sites that the published union does not have; 0 ProtVar pairs listed as served returned no model
